adapter_abi.name: Spark2_5Adapter
non_goals: native execution in this preparation task
an adapter that pretends to load Spark before backend qualification
reusing MiniCPM5 width-2048 connectors or serialized fast states
adapter_abi.purpose: A dedicated adapter for the custom spark2_5 architecture, including frozen-base input-gradient paths and later new modules. It is not a Llama or MiniCPM5 adapter.

adapter_hazards: spark2_5 is a custom auto_map architecture; a Llama or MiniCPM5 adapter cannot load it
the model hard-codes model.embedding, model.layers[i], model.norm; inject through a wrapper, not by editing upstream files
DynamicCache sharing and absent sliding eviction change memory-growth assumptions
no lm_head tensor is serialized; tying must be verified after load
the residual stream is float32 while layer compute follows each linear dtype; mixed-precision bookkeeping is required
gradient checkpointing re-enters a layer without past_key_values; cache use must be disabled during training

backend_dependencies.apple_mps: not mentioned by upstream; MPS FP8 kernel support is unproven
backend_dependencies.attention_kernels: none imported; the custom code uses eager matmul (no flash_attn/causal_conv1d/triton)
backend_dependencies.compressed_tensors: 0.16.0 for float-quantized loading; required for the FP8 source
backend_dependencies.python: >=3.12 per repository; exact upstream interpreter not qualified
backend_dependencies.torch: required; exact wheel/version not pinned by the checkpoint
backend_dependencies.transformers: 4.57.x semantics required (FP8 config serialized 4.57.6, BF16 4.57.1); isolated from the project's locked MiniCPM5 environment

decoder.attention: custom Spark2_5Attention, fused q_k_v_proj, eager matmul attention
decoder.attention_schedule: three sliding_attention blocks then one full_attention block, repeated nine times

cache.note: sliding layers receive a sliding causal mask, but DynamicCache does not evict old keys/values; do not claim constant-memory sliding cache

decoder.norm: Spark2_5RMSNorm computes in float32, multiplies float32 weight, casts back
decoder.residual_stream: inputs_embeds.float(); each layer casts to its MLP gate_proj weight dtype

generation.token_budget: caller-supplied; generation_config max_tokens is not a qualification

official_bf16.status: Blocked pending a backend that supports compressed-tensors storage on the selected device. No local BF16 execution either.

official_fp8.status: Unqualified. Requires an isolated transformers 4.57.x + compressed-tensors environment and a supported FP8 kernel path. Upstream provides no MPS evidence.

official_bf16.status: Proposed. BF16 eager attention should support input gradients; must be demonstrated, not inferred.

official_fp8.status: Unknown. Compressed-tensors linear layers may propagate input gradients, but MPS FP8 activation-quantization autograd is unproven.

official_bf16.status: Proposed for the BF16 control under the same frozen-base contract.

official_fp8.status: Not applicable while the quantized base is frozen. The trainable projector must still receive input gradients; no_grad around the decoder contradicts that path.

official_bf16.status: Proposed experiment only after a measured update/reload qualification on the control.

official_fp8.status: Deferred. FP8 training kernels, master-copy policy, scaling and optimizer support are absent locally.

official_bf16.status: Same new-module policy; base membership differs by experiment.

official_fp8.status: Frozen base has no optimizer state. New projector/LoRA parameters use a declared optimizer; Muon int8 momentum is limited to audited eligible groups.

official_bf16.status: Proposed. Persist BF16 base identity plus the same new-module schema; reject a cross-precision reload.

official_fp8.status: Proposed. Persist the original FP8 storage identity plus new trainable tensors; reload in a fresh process without changing format.

official_bf16.status: Same structural caveat with BF16 storage and a larger byte footprint.

official_fp8.status: Unqualified. DynamicCache does not evict sliding-window keys; the 512-token window is a mask, not a bounded cache. Configured 1,048,576 positions are not a measured capacity.

official_bf16.status: Not applicable to BF16 training evidence.

official_fp8.status: Not admitted. Spark-MLX-LLM is a separate implementation and must be pinned and qualified; it is not PyTorch/MPS training evidence.

identity.statement: The FP8 and BF16 artifacts are separate official Hub repositories at separate immutable revisions with different weight storage.
